subcategory_text: Communications and control networks are protected.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SC-7, SC-8, AC-4
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.8.22 (Segregation of networks), A.8.24
implementation_examples: Protect communications and control networks (ICS/OT, building management, telemetry) through segmentation, dedicated controls, and integrity monitoring
Coordinate with operations teams on shared technology stacks
Test the protections against known attack patterns
assessment_objectives: Determine whether communications and control networks are segmented and protected
Determine whether integrity monitoring is in place
Determine whether the protection pattern is tested against relevant attack patterns
Determine whether ownership responsibilities for control networks are clear
